text: HEXIS is the brand of HEXIS SAS, a French maker of self-adhesive films based in Frontignan. HEXIS says Michel Mateu founded the company in 1989; France's official companies directory (Recherche d'entreprises, RNE) lists Caroline Mateu as president of the SAS, Clement Mateu as director-general and Michel Mateu as deputy director-general.
short: HEXIS SAS: founded by Michel Mateu (1989); the Mateu family holds its top offices.
